name: Manastorm raids: Onyxia, Garr and Firesworn carry dungeon-scale health (#12033)
contract: Player report (#12033): raid stages in Manastorm were far too tanky. Their creatures kept forty-player health, and
flex health (coa_boss_flex) sized Onyxia and the Molten Core bosses for ten players, even again on the pull.
Before the fix a depth-1 level-60 run measured Onyxia at 5,052,348 (842,058 x 10 x 0.6), Garr at 31,507,320
(1,105,520 x 10 x 0.6 x 4.75 for 15 Chaotic Link stacks) and Firesworn at 59,749. Flex health now leaves
Manastorm stages alone, and Manastorm divides raid creature health by the median HealthModifier gap to level-60
dungeons: bosses 292.03 / 29.0, elite trash 41.25 / 4.0. Onyxia's expansion-2 template is rebased on the
Classic base health. Expected at depth 1 (x0.6), level 60: Onyxia 3052 x 520 / 10.07 x 0.6 = 94,562;
keep that health after the pull.
